title: Longest Common Substring Length
description: Given two lowercase strings `s1` and `s2`, return the length of the longest contiguous substring that appears in both `s1` and `s2`. Return `0` if they share no common character.
constraints: s1 and s2 consist of lowercase English letters.
hints: Let dp[i][j] be the length of the longest common suffix of s1[:i] and s2[:j].
If s1[i - 1] == s2[j - 1], dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1] + 1; otherwise 0. Optimize to O(min(|s1|, |s2|)) space by iterating j backward.

examples.explanation: "abcd" is the longest common contiguous substring of "abcdxyz" and "xyzabcd", with length 4.
